title: Design, synthesis, in vitro cytotoxic activity, and in silico studies of symmetrical chlorophenylamino-s-triazine derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,41169-41188
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05705A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Em Canh Pham, Song-Thuong Nguyen, Kim Anh Thi Le, Tuoi Thi Hong Do, Tuyen Ngoc Truong
Chlorophenylamino-s-triazine derivatives were synthesized and tested for anticancer activity against MCF7 and C26 cells. Promising compounds showed therapeutic potential and favorable drug-like properties via in silico docking and ADMET analyses.
